scripts.build: npm run build -w @dashboard/shared && npm run build -w @dashboard/api && npm run build -w @dashboard/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @dashboard/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @dashboard/shared && npm run test -w @dashboard/api && node --import tsx --test apps/web/test/*.test.ts
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @dashboard/shared && npm run dev -w @dashboard/api
